name: Kubernetes
label: Kubernetes kube-apiserver REST
description: Kubernetes API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/. Operations: get, list, apply, delete, patch (core /api/v1 only — pods/services/configmaps, not apps/v1 Deployments), scale (/apis/apps/v1 .../scale), logs (GET .../pods/{name}/log), job_create (/apis/batch/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/jobs), listen. Auth secret token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: get | list | apply | delete | patch | scale | logs | job_create | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'get'.

schema.label: resource
schema.description: Resource plural for core v1 (pods, services, configmaps) or apps (deployments, statefulsets). Path {resource}.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Object name. Path {name} for get/delete/patch/scale/logs. Example: web-7d9f.

schema.label: metadata
schema.description: Kubernetes ObjectMeta for apply / job_create. Official metadata {name, labels, annotations}.

schema.label: spec
schema.description: Kubernetes spec for apply / patch / scale / job_create. Official spec.

schema.label: kind
schema.description: Kind for apply / job_create. Example: Deployment | Job.

schema.label: apiVersion
schema.description: apiVersion for apply / job_create. Example: apps/v1 | batch/v1.

schema.label: replicas
schema.description: Desired replica count for scale. Wired to spec.replicas. Example: 3.

schema.label: manifest
schema.description: Full Kubernetes resource manifest for apply / job_create (apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec). Example: {"apiVersion":"v1","kind":"ConfigMap","metadata":{"name":"app"},"data":{"k":"v}}.

schema.label: patch
schema.description: JSON merge-patch body for patch operation. Example: {"spec":{"replicas":3}}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: get, list, apply, delete, patch, scale, logs, job_create, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: Service-account or user bearer token. Never log. Do not mount host kubeconfig paths into the sandbox.

configurationParameters.label: API Server
configurationParameters.description: Kubernetes API server origin (scheme + host[:port], no trailing slash). Empty uses the in-cluster address https://kubernetes.default.svc. The server certificate must be trusted by the default JDK trust store. Example: https://k8s.example.com:6443.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Manifest
configurationParameters.description: Full Kubernetes resource manifest for apply / job_create (apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec). Example: {"apiVersion":"v1","kind":"ConfigMap","metadata":{"name":"app"},"data":{"k":"v}}.

configurationParameters.label: Patch
configurationParameters.description: JSON merge-patch body for patch operation. Example: {"spec":{"replicas":3}}.
